article.title: Liquidator not to deposit monies into private banking account.
article.content:
351Liquidator not to deposit monies into private banking account.

Section 351  ·  Chapter XX  ·  Part III  ·  page 193 of the Act
Neither the Official Liquidator nor the Company Liquidator of a company shall deposit any monies received by him in his capacity as such into any private banking account.
